summary: The nonexistence proof is correct. The cone-cell decompositions are exhaustive up to null boundaries, the strict negative-quadrant turn yields the claimed small total beta-gamma-strip budget, the two axis-clip estimates give the stated aspect-ratio bound, and the forced-triangle estimates correctly reduce all three radial reaches of the u-cell below p/6. The resulting upper bound u<p^2/72 contradicts the independently derived strict lower bound u>89(q/p)p^2/450>p^2/72. All arithmetic, inequality directions, strictness claims, and uses of the accepted predecessor facts check out.
